A single page (the “QCEW – About the Data” page from the California EDD website) is shown.  
It describes the Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) program, its sources, use, and the general form of its data, but it does **not** provide any state‑level employment numbers, NAEP 8th‑grade math scores, Census population estimates, or any other data that would answer the user’s multi‑criteria question.  

The page contains the following concrete facts (with exact quotations from the supplied text):

| Fact | Exact Quotation | Source |
|------|----------------|--------|
|1|“The Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages (QCEW) Program is a federal/state cooperative program between the U.S. Department of Labor’s Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) and the California EDD’s Labor Market Information Division (LMID).” | QCEW – About the Data |
|2|“The Bureau of Labor Statistics publishes new QCEW data in its County Employment and Wages news release on a quarterly basis.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|3|“The QCEW data are also published through the [Create Customized Tables] system and full quarterly industry detail data at all geographic levels.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|4|“Employment data under the QCEW program represent the number of the state’s UI‑covered workers who worked during, or received pay for, the pay period which includes the 12th of the month.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|5|“Excluded are members of the armed forces, the self‑employed, proprietors, domestic workers, and unpaid family workers. Railroad workers covered by the Railroad Unemployment Insurance system are also excluded.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|6|“The QCEW data include employment and wages for workers covered by California Unemployment Insurance laws and federal agencies covered by the Unemployment Compensation for Federal Employees (UCFE) program.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|7|“The QCEW data are used by the Current Employment Statistics (CES) program and the Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) program.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|8|“Data from the QCEW program are used as an input for many BLS programs, including the CES and OEWS.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|9|“The QCEW data serve as an input to the BLS publication of the National Compensation Survey, the Current Employment Statistics (CES) program, and the Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics (OEWS) program.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|10|“The data are also used to determine the federal allocation of program grants to state and local governments.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|11|The page lists two navigation menus: “Data Search Tools” and “Online Services.” | QCEW – About the Data |
|12|The page’s footer identifies the publication date as 2026. | QCEW – About the Data |
